name: IPA Media Research — Website & CMS
description: Single Next.js 15 (App Router) codebase for IPA — Institute of Public Accountability, organized into two route-group panels under src/app/: (site)/ is the public media-research observatory website (/, /about, /work, /team, /contact, /investigation/<id>) with server pages + client sections in _components/, and (dashboard)/cms is the CMS dashboard at /cms with real per-section routes, an API-backed client (api/cms/**), and MySQL persistence via Prisma.
